items.title: Jack Sheldon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: I see some old movies with Bing Crosby where they just have his face in there for two choruses... we did a tribute to Bing Crosby.

ctx.x: What’s your dream project? If you had a project that you had a backer for in film or live music or recording. Have you got something in your mind that you would just love to make happen?

Well yeah a bunch of stuff. I’d love to have a T.V. show, a comedy show about my big band with all the stories of all the guys in the band and all the girls and all the stuff that can happen with a big band, how interesting it can be, and how great it would be with the music and the jazz and everything. Now that’s a thought, I don’t know if anybody’s ever even thought of that. They think of the music as it’s hard to hold the people. But I don’t think that’s true though. I see some old movies with Bing Crosby…
